description: Use when the user asks how the price of one destination developed over time ("jak se vyvíjela cena letenek do Egypta?", "price history for Egypt"). Price series for one destination: measured span, stats, a downsampled sample of points and any regime breaks. Historical observations only, never a live quote or a recommendation. Each rail's `searched.stay_nights` is the trip length its points price, and a destination's flight and package rails can differ - state it when citing a number. A rail without `resort` covers the whole destination, so after `resolved_from` cite it under the destination's name, not the resort's. `other_parties_in_country` names the related pages that publish a party this destination does not (e.g. a solo series on a city): cite it instead of saying that party is not tracked. When you answer from this, say where the latest price sits in its own history and stop there: do not tell the reader to buy, book, wait, avoid or which destination to pick - the series carries no trend, volatility or live availability, so that judgement stays the reader's.

destination.description: destination slug, as returned by list_destinations. A RESORT key read off a rail (e.g. 'hurghada') also resolves, to its parent destination, and the answer then carries `resolved_from`; underscores and hyphens are interchangeable.

name: price_history

country.description: the one country page this city belongs to, where the catalogue names exactly one

note.description: present when the `rail` filter matched nothing published for this destination

other_parties_in_country.description: parties a `related` page publishes and this destination does not - e.g. a solo series on a city of this country

arrivals.description: arrival airports RECORDED; covers_all_published_prices is false

latest_stale_after_days.description: this rail's own freshness boundary, in days after measured.to

price_covers.description: what the money buys - airfare only, or a package as offered

regime_breaks.description: [from, to] date spans where the series was not comparable

searched.description: the search mode (and fixed dates, where there are any) the series was collected under, and `stay_nights` {from, to}: how long a trip each point prices - the flight and package rails of one destination can differ

series_sample.description: a DOWNSAMPLED sample; `complete` says whether it is the whole series

related.description: the other tracked pages in the same country (a country lists its cities); a party or rail missing here may exist on one of them

resolved_from.description: Present when the caller named a RESORT key; the answer is its parent destination.

same_airport_as.description: pages whose flight rail lands at an airport this one records - measured from a different departure cluster (see `origins`), so their numbers differ for a reason

anyOf.description: tool-level failure, returned with isError: true

title: Price history
